summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.2 - Introduction to Other Features ## Major Update to the Drawing Library In the 2025.2 version, we introduced a major update for the new drawing library. In the previous version, the new drawing library could only exist in the form of a suspended window. The 2025.2 line is available for both options: you can keep the original form of the drawing library, or choose to stop it at the side of the column. After clicking the drawing library icon, the drawing library will open randomly in the form of a suspended window. To stop the drawing library, you need to click the stop icon in the upper right corner. The drawing library will automatically stop at the left side of the screen column. You can also choose to stop the drawing library at the right side of the column. The window and property editor are shown in a row. If you need to remove the stop icon and restore the suspended window, simply click the window icon in the upper right corner of the drawing library. When you complete the stop or remove the stop of the drawing library, this user name setting will be saved and will automatically work when you start the software next time. This function allows CLO to adapt to different work processes and helps users customize their user interface. ### Removal of the Original Drawing Library With the update of the new drawing library, the original old drawing library will be removed. In this new version, we are in the user customized settings. ## New Shortcut and Unlock Feature In the new version, we apply a new shortcut and unlock feature. After opening the user customized window setting, you can use the unlock option in the shortcut selection card. This lock feature also supports order name and shortcut query. You can directly enter the name keyword or complete name to search for shortcut keys. When there is a shortcut conflict, you will see a window where you can choose whether to replace it. This new unlock function can help save your time, especially when searching for specific tools, menu shortcuts, or getting shortcut options. ### Major Update to Shortcut Code The 2025.2 version has made a significant update to the shortcut code. Users can now look directly at and edit all the shortcuts in the 2D window. The sewing line will also be linked to the shortcut to ensure that the structure is exactly the same. In the 2D window, you can see the shortcuts on the codeboard, which automatically follows the size and displays in all sizes. Switch to the edit code tool, and after selecting the shortcut, you can adjust the position in the property editor. Click on the fixed size to lock the shortcut code position, ensuring that the position of the shortcut is the same as the codeboard and remains unchanged in all other sizes. ## Display and Position Adjustments in 2D Window Open the length of the display line in the 2D window. When switching sizes, you can see that the distance between the shortcuts remains unchanged. If you need to modify it to keep the distance from another shortcut unchanged, use the shortcut tool to select the shortcut and click on lock in the property editor. The lock position will change from the start point to the end point. You can also enter a number to change the distance while keeping the original distance unchanged. Switch to other sizes, and you will see that the length of the other endpoint remains unchanged. If you need to edit further, you can manually enter the number in the table according to the actual situation. ### Editing Specific Size Directions If you need to reverse a specific size direction, you can add a comma before the number. For reversing all sizes, simply choose the opposite direction. Use the edit sewing line tool to switch to other sizes, ensuring that the sewing lines are perfectly aligned at the cutout. This update has realized the linkage of all sizes of the sewing line and the cutout. Therefore, when the chest coat switches between different sizes, the sewing line will always follow the cutout, improving the accuracy of the number and the overall number of the board. ## Enhanced 2D Measurement Functions In the CLO 2025.2 version, based on accurate 2D measurement, the placement of the drawing will become more convenient. Use the adjustment sticker tool to select the sticker that needs adjustment. In the property editor, you can activate the 2D measurement function based on the endpoint or the outer line. This is used to operate the endpoint. First, select it at the bottom, and you will see a distance parameter displayed next to the sticker within the sheet's range. You can manually enter the value to accurately control the distance between the endpoint or the outer line of the sticker. ### Fixing Needle Tool Updates In this version, we updated the selection option of the fixing needle tool. You can now delete all the fixing needles on the selected sheet. Use the fixing needle tool to add fixing needles to different sheets at random. Select any fixing needle, right-click, and delete the fixing needles on the selected sheet. In the previous version, there were only two options: delete the selected fixing needles or delete all the fixing needles. Now, you can delete all the fixing needles on the selected sheet without affecting the entire suit, providing greater flexibility for creating 3D clothing. ## Enhanced Sewing Functionality In the 2025.2 version, you can choose whether to activate the sewing. Open the sewing tool to add the sewing line at the neck or create a random sewing line on the clothing. Find the activation option in the property editor, open the simulation, re-select the activation sewing line, and simulate again. In the previous version, once sewing was applied, it would always exist unless deleted. This version allows you to select to stop the sewing option after adding it. You can also apply the activation option on the virtual model in any position, adding the sewing effect and simulating again for increased flexibility. ### Software Model Simulation in GPU Mode Previously, only CPU simulation supported the software model simulation. After this update, software model simulation can also be used in GPU simulation mode. Click on the virtual model in the property editor to find and activate the software model simulation option. You will see the 3D window in the bottom right corner display the software model simulation icon. When you switch from simulation mode to GPU mode and re-simulate, the virtual model as the software model will start to simulate. ## Customization of Hats In the 2025.2 version, you can customize the hat as a configuration. Find the virtual model in the main menu, select the customized configuration, and in the pop-up window, you will see that the hat option has been added. You can import an OBJ file or customize the version as a hat. After completing the other option settings, click Save to save it as a customized configuration. After customizing, you can freely add the hat to other projects, allowing you to explore more possibilities. ## MetaHuman Integration From the 2025.2 version, you can import MetaHuman as a virtual model. You can import MetaHuman in the main menu in the DNA format. Ensure that the DNA file is stored under the same path as other postage files for correct skin presentation. In the MetaHuman DNA import window, click the File plus icon to select the corresponding MetaHuman body and head file. You can modify various settings in the import window, such as unit and proportion, and manually increase the arrangement point if desired. ### Pull Chain Functionality In the 2025.2 version, the pull chain can be copied to the version with a symmetrical relationship. When you right-click on the pull chain and select to copy to the version with symmetrical modification, the pull chain will be copied to the other side of the version. The copied pull chain will retain the same material and specifications as the original. ## Text Editor Updates The 2025.2 version supports text rotation both horizontally and vertically. When you want to rotate text, select it and click directly to rotate. This function allows you to create patterns and prints more quickly and freely. ### UV Editor Optimization From this version, you can quickly and accurately select versions based on the same property in the UV editor. Open the UV editor window to see the version of the pull chain. When the mouse hovers over the list of the same properties, purple options will display, including the particle structure layer and the material. You can easily select the version, move to the target UV area, or bake the UV. The same applies to the particle structure layer. ## Animation Improvements After this update, you can apply key needles to more extensive properties, including pressure-proof sewing needles and accessories. The usability of the animation editor has improved significantly. The animation editor will automatically open when you set the key needle, streamlining the workflow. You can add multiple functions to simplify the addition and editing of cross-layer key needles, and create key needles for multiple object layers in the scene. Use the Ctrl or Shift key to select multiple object layers and create key needles for all selected layers simultaneously. ### Key Needle Functionality From this version, you can create a new key needle by changing settings in the support menu. The switch and click button in the upper-right corner are the key needle of the animation editor, providing a new key for all object layers. ## New Rendering Control Features In the 2025.2 version, when rendering a rotating picture, you can set the start and end needles. If rendering stops, you can enter the starting needle to restart rendering from the input needle. This update enhances control over the rotating picture. ## Workflow Efficiency and Cost Saving We have released a new function for checking workflow efficiency and current cost savings.
